activities.title: Refuel at Flower Child
activities.description: Join the South End wellness crowd for a bright, health-conscious Wednesday lunch. The vibrant atmosphere and inclusive vibe make it a baseline social hub for the neighborhood's active residents.

activities.title: Darts & Drafts at Old Pineville Pub
activities.description: Discover the local secret of LoSo at this unpretentious neighborhood bar. It’s a reliable, low-key baseline for a Tuesday night involving local craft beers and a competitive game of darts.
activities.location: Old Pineville Premium Pub, Lower South End

activities.title: Patio Pints at Suffolk Punch
activities.description: Experience the massive hybrid taphouse and coffee bar right on the Blue Line. It’s a premier Wednesday evening social destination where the Rail Trail community converges for brews and small plates.

activities.title: Rooftop Brews at Giddy Goat
activities.description: Enjoy a morning roast or an afternoon pint on the expansive rooftop of this eclectic Plaza Midwood coffee house. It is a high-energy social hub perfect for meeting the city's creative class.
activities.location: Giddy Goat Coffee Roasters, Plaza Midwood

activities.title: Late Night Pizza at Benny Pennello's
activities.description: Grab a massive, legendary slice at this NoDa window as the bars start to clear out. It is the quintessential late-night food baseline for the neighborhood’s adventurous social crowd.

activities.title: Social Tennis at Jeff Adams Center
activities.description: Join a pick-up match at this massive public tennis facility known for its active and welcoming community. It is a foundational sports baseline for the city's fitness-focused socialites.
activities.location: Jeff Adams Tennis Center, North End

activities.title: Patio Pints at Pop the Top
activities.description: Settle in with a curated NC craft beer at this cozy, inclusive bottle shop and taproom. It is a welcoming social baseline for a relaxed transition from the afternoon into the evening.
activities.location: Pop the Top Craft Beer Shop, South End

activities.title: Boutique Retail at Moxie Mercantile
activities.description: Discover curated home goods and jewelry in this charming historic house turned shop. It is a baseline for finding unique, locally-sourced gifts in the vibrant heart of Plaza Midwood.

activities.title: Karaoke & BBQ at Seoul Food
activities.description: Feast on Korean-fusion BBQ before heading to a private karaoke room with your social circle. This venue is a South End staple known for its massive, playground-style outdoor patio.
activities.location: Seoul Food Meat Co, South End

activities.title: Social Games at Queen Park Social
activities.description: Compete in bowling, shuffleboard, and vintage arcade games in a sprawling warehouse setting. It is the go-to spot in LoSo for large groups seeking high-energy entertainment.

activities.title: Juicy Jay's at Legion Brewing
activities.description: Settle onto the balcony at this neighborhood brewery for a pint of their famous hazy IPA. It’s a quintessential Plaza Midwood hangout for locals who value high-energy social scenes.

activities.title: Rooftop Views at Wooden Robot
activities.description: Enjoy a Good Morning Vietnam coffee vanilla cream ale while overlooking the South End skyline. This brewery is a staple for its inclusive atmosphere and prime Rail Trail real estate.

activities.title: Tapas at Barcelona Wine Bar
activities.description: Experience the high-energy, Mediterranean vibes of this bustling South End wine bar. It is a premier social baseline for sharing small plates and heavy pours on a lively patio.

activities.title: IPAs at Heist Brewery
activities.description: Head to this converted industrial space for award-winning IPAs and a full kitchen menu. It’s a staple for NoDa socialites who appreciate a gritty but polished brewery experience.

activities.title: Gas Station Social at 1501 South Mint
activities.description: Lounge at this converted 1930s gas station that has become a premier social hub for the city’s diverse and queer communities. The outdoor patio is the place to be for Sunday Funday or a high-vibe evening.

activities.title: Fusion Bites at The Cowfish
activities.description: Brave the crowds for the legendary 'Burgushi' in a vibrant, high-energy atmosphere that has been a city staple for over a decade. It is a loud, fun, and adventurous culinary crossroads.
activities.location: The Cowfish Sushi Burger Bar, SouthPark

activities.title: Literary Walk at The Green
activities.description: Wander through this whimsical, 1.5-acre urban park dedicated to literature, featuring sculptures and water features. It is a serene but culturally rich baseline for an afternoon stroll through Uptown.

activities.title: Patio Tacos at RuRu's Tacos & Tequila
activities.description: Mingle on one of the city's most beautiful historic patios with a margarita in hand. This Myers Park favorite is a high-visibility social hub for the young professional and creative crowd.

activities.title: Bikes & BBQ at Mac's Speed Shop
activities.description: Lean into the gritty, high-energy vibe of this South End institution known for its massive patio and extensive beer list. It is a quintessential social crossroads for bikers, locals, and visitors.

activities.title: Light Rail Brews at Triple C
activities.description: Sip award-winning beers in this sprawling South End warehouse featuring a high-energy taproom and outdoor space. It is a foundational social spot for the neighborhood’s craft beer enthusiasts.
activities.location: Triple C Brewing Co, South End

activities.title: Free Birding Walk
activities.description: Start your morning with a refreshing guided birding walk on the scenic trails of Stowe Conservancy. It's a fantastic way to connect with nature and enjoy the outdoors, perfect for all skill levels.

activities.title: Free Fun Fridays with YScholars
activities.description: Join YScholars for a morning of free, family-friendly activities at the Johnston YMCA. Expect engaging programs and community interaction, making for a lively start to your Friday.

activities.title: Finally Fridays - Asian Night Market
activities.description: Experience a vibrant Asian Night Market at Urban District Market. This free-entry event features local vendors, delicious food trucks, karaoke, and live entertainment, offering a lively evening atmosphere.

activities.title: BOOM Charlotte Festival (Free Options)
activities.description: Dive into the diverse arts scene at the BOOM Charlotte Festival in University City. While there are ticketed events, many free performances and installations are available, offering a taste of local and international talent.
activities.location: The Boardwalk at University City, University City

activities.title: Friday Night Monarch Market Comedy Showcase
activities.description: Catch a free comedy show featuring top local and touring comedians at the intimate Aster event space within Monarch Market. Grab a bite from one of the market's many restaurants before the laughs begin.

activities.title: Music Bingo at Primal Brewery
activities.description: Test your musical knowledge and enjoy a fun night of Music Bingo at Primal Brewery in Huntersville. It's free to play and offers a relaxed, social atmosphere with great brews.

activities.title: Traditional Trivia at NoDa Brewing
activities.description: Gather your friends for a classic trivia night at NoDa Brewing Company. It's free to play and a perfect opportunity to show off your general knowledge while enjoying craft beers in a popular brewery setting.

activities.title: AAPI 5K
activities.description: Participate in Charlotte's first-ever AAPI 5K, hosted by Pace of the East at Urban District Market. Whether you run or walk, it's a great way to engage with the community and support a good cause.

activities.title: Crafter's Market at Historic Rosedale
activities.description: Browse unique, handmade items from local artists and craftspeople at the Crafter's Market at Historic Rosedale. Enjoy the picturesque grounds and find one-of-a-kind treasures.

activities.title: Free Comic Book Day
activities.description: Celebrate Free Comic Book Day at various participating locations across Charlotte. Pick up free comic books and discover new stories and artists. A fun event for all ages and comic enthusiasts.

activities.title: Kings Drive Art Walk
activities.description: Stroll along the Little Sugar Creek Greenway and explore the Kings Drive Art Walk, showcasing fine and emerging artists. This outdoor festival offers free admission and a chance to appreciate local art.

activities.title: Piedmont Art and Cultural Exchange
activities.description: Head to Downtown Mt. Holly for the Piedmont Art and Cultural Exchange. This free event features live music, community art, live art demonstrations, and local vendors, celebrating regional culture.

activities.title: Kandace Springs Jazz Concert
activities.description: Experience the soulful sounds of Kandace Springs live at Middle C Jazz. Enjoy an intimate evening of world-class jazz in one of Charlotte's premier music venues. Early show tickets are often more affordable.

activities.title: River Jam: Evan Blackerby and the Bandwagon
activities.description: Head to the U.S. National Whitewater Center for River Jam, featuring live music by Evan Blackerby and the Bandwagon. Enjoy the outdoor atmosphere and riverside tunes; parking is typically the only cost.

activities.title: Ultimate Drag Queen Bingo & Drag Show
activities.description: Get ready for a fabulous night of Ultimate Drag Queen Bingo and a dazzling drag show at Morton's The Steakhouse. Expect high energy, laughs, and fierce performances. Entry or bingo cards are typically under $20.

activities.title: Trap Karaoke: Charlotte
activities.description: Unleash your inner superstar at Trap Karaoke: Charlotte at The Fillmore. This high-energy event lets you perform your favorite trap hits on a professional stage. Grab your tickets for a night of unforgettable fun.
activities.location: The Fillmore Charlotte, AvidXchange Music Factory

activities.title: Shinyribs Live at Neighborhood Theatre
activities.description: Catch the unique blend of swamp-pop, country, and soul from Shinyribs at the historic Neighborhood Theatre. It's a lively show promising great music and a fantastic atmosphere.

activities.title: Kawaii Rave: 18+
activities.description: Dance the night away at the Kawaii Rave (18+) at The Underground. Expect a vibrant atmosphere with electronic music and a crowd ready to party. Perfect for those looking for a high-energy night out.

activities.title: Bangzz Concert at Snug Harbor
activities.description: Enjoy a raw and energetic performance by Bangzz at Snug Harbor, a beloved Plaza Midwood dive bar known for its live music. Expect a night of rock and a genuine Charlotte music scene experience.

activities.title: Buff Faye's Drag Brunch
activities.description: Join Charlotte's #1 voted drag brunch, Buff Faye's Drag Brunch, at Midtown Tavern. Your ticket includes a fabulous show by Buff Faye and her divas, with food and drinks available for purchase separately.

activities.title: Sabor & Slay International Sensations Drag Brunch
activities.description: Celebrate Cinco de Mayo weekend with Sabor & Slay: International Sensations Drag Brunch by The Vanity House at Catalú. Expect dazzling drag, international music, and a global fiesta of performances.

activities.title: Charlotte' NColor Festival
activities.description: Celebrate Black history, culture, and storytelling at the Charlotte' NColor Festival. This event features music, food, games, and more, with pay-what-you-can passes to ensure accessibility.

activities.title: The Charlotte Margarita Festival
activities.description: Sip, savor, and spice things up at The Charlotte Margarita Festival at Tipsy Pickle. Enjoy margarita tastings, food, and festive vibes. General admission tickets are available for under $20.

activities.title: Charlotte - Tacos & Margs Crawl®
activities.description: Join the ultimate taco & margarita fiesta taking over South End's best bars with the Tacos & Margs Crawl®. Expect packed patios, DJs, and exclusive specials. General Admission is typically under $20.

activities.title: DRAGO Charities Drag Brunch
activities.description: Attend the DRAGO Charities Drag Brunch benefiting the Gay Men's Chorus of Charlotte at Snooze, an A.M. Eatery. Enjoy fierce performances and delicious brunch while supporting a local cause.
activities.location: Snooze, an A.M. Eatery, South End

activities.title: Free Throw - Moments Before The Wind Tour
activities.description: Catch Free Throw on their 'Moments Before The Wind Tour' at The Underground. This is a great opportunity to see a touring band in an intimate venue. Tickets are typically affordable for general admission.

activities.title: BOOM Charlotte Festival Opening Night
activities.description: Kick off the multi-day BOOM Charlotte Festival with diverse arts performances including dance, music, and spoken word. Individual show tickets or a Fringe Pass offer an affordable way to experience boundary-pushing art.
activities.location: The Boardwalk at University City, University City

activities.title: Chelsea Handler: The High and Mighty Tour
activities.description: Catch comedian Chelsea Handler live on her 'The High and Mighty Tour' at Ovens Auditorium. Expect her signature sharp wit and hilarious takes on current events and personal anecdotes.

activities.title: River Jam: Evan Blackerby and the Bandwagon
activities.description: Enjoy a free outdoor concert at the U.S. National Whitewater Center as Evan Blackerby and the Bandwagon take the stage. It's a perfect evening for live music by the river.
activities.location: U.S. National Whitewater Center, West Charlotte

activities.title: We Will Rock You (Musical)
activities.description: Experience the Broadway classic 'We Will Rock You' at the Booth Playhouse. This musical features the iconic songs of Queen and a captivating story set in a dystopian future.

activities.title: Swagga First Friday
activities.description: Join Charlotte Nightlife Entertainment for 'Swagga First Friday' featuring the premier go-go band 'Uptown Swagga' and V101.9's DJ Rolodexx. Enjoy food and drink specials with free parking.

activities.title: Monarch Market Comedy Showcase
activities.description: Enjoy a free comedy show in Uptown Charlotte at the Monarch Market's intimate Aster event space. Featuring top local and touring comedians, it's a great way to get laughs and grab a bite from the market's vendors.
activities.location: Monarch Market by Crescent Communities, Uptown

activities.title: BOOM Charlotte Festival Day 2
activities.description: Continue to explore the BOOM Charlotte Festival, offering a full day of diverse artistic performances, including dance, music, theater, and visual arts installations.
activities.location: The Boardwalk at University City, University City

activities.title: Cinco de Mayo Celebration at Camp North End
activities.description: Celebrate Cinco de Mayo at Camp North End's Boileryard. Enjoy live music, authentic Mexican food, dancing, and a vibrant atmosphere with free admission.
activities.location: The Boileryard at Camp North End, North End

activities.title: We Will Rock You (Musical) Matinee
activities.description: Catch a matinee performance of the hit musical 'We Will Rock You' at the Booth Playhouse. A fantastic opportunity to enjoy Queen's music and a compelling story.

activities.title: Lenny Boy Yoga & Kombucha
activities.description: Start your Saturday with a beginner-friendly vinyasa flow yoga class at Lenny Boy Brewing Co. Your $5 entry includes the class and a refreshing 6oz kombucha.

activities.title: The Flamingo Revue: Electric Flamingos
activities.description: Experience 'The Flamingo Revue Presents: Electric Flamingos' at Visulite Theatre. This show promises a night of vibrant performances and entertainment.

activities.title: AAPI Heritage Month 5K
activities.description: Participate in the first Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage Month 5K. Run or walk through the XCLT greenway and Cordelia Park, celebrating cultural diversity and fitness.

activities.title: OCEANIC Live at Visulite Theatre
activities.description: Catch a live performance by the band OCEANIC at the historic Visulite Theatre. This is a great opportunity to see an emerging act in an intimate setting.

activities.title: BOOM Charlotte Festival All-Access Pass
activities.description: Immerse yourself fully in the BOOM Charlotte Festival with an all-access weekend pass. Enjoy three days of diverse, boundary-pushing art, music, dance, and theater across multiple venues.
activities.location: The Boardwalk at University City, University City

activities.title: Chef's Tasting Menu at The Fig Tree
activities.description: Indulge in an exquisite multi-course Chef's Tasting Menu at the acclaimed Fig Tree Restaurant. This fine dining experience offers a curated selection of seasonal dishes in an elegant setting.

activities.title: Charlotte Symphony Orchestra: Masterworks Series
activities.description: Experience the grandeur of the Charlotte Symphony Orchestra's Masterworks Series at the Knight Theater. Enjoy a program of classical masterpieces performed by world-class musicians.

activities.title: VIP Experience at QC Social Lounge
activities.description: Elevate your Friday night with a VIP experience at QC Social Lounge. Enjoy bottle service and exclusive seating in one of Charlotte's premier nightlife destinations.

activities.title: Exclusive Art Gala Opening at Mint Museum Uptown
activities.description: Attend a ticketed opening reception for a new major exhibition at the Mint Museum Uptown. Mingle with artists and art enthusiasts while enjoying cocktails and hors d'oeuvres.

activities.title: October London & Lalah Hathaway Concert
activities.description: Enjoy a soulful evening of R&B with October London and Lalah Hathaway at Ovens Auditorium. Prepare for smooth vocals and timeless music from these acclaimed artists.

activities.title: BOOM Charlotte Festival All-Access Pass Day 2
activities.description: Utilize your all-access weekend pass for the second day of the BOOM Charlotte Festival. Dive deeper into the diverse array of artistic expressions and performances.
activities.location: The Boardwalk at University City, University City

activities.title: Plies 40 & Up With A Good Job All White Affair Day Party
activities.description: Attend the exclusive 'Plies 40 & Up With A Good Job All White Affair Day Party'. This high-end event promises a sophisticated atmosphere and great music.

activities.title: Charlotte FC Home Game (Premium Seats)
activities.description: Cheer on Charlotte FC from premium seats at Bank of America Stadium. Experience the electric atmosphere of a Major League Soccer match with enhanced amenities.

activities.title: Broadway at Blumenthal: Hamilton
activities.description: Secure your tickets for a premium viewing of the acclaimed Broadway hit 'Hamilton' at the Belk Theater. This revolutionary musical is a must-see theatrical event.

activities.title: Exclusive Wine Tasting & Dinner
activities.description: Indulge in an exclusive wine tasting paired with a gourmet dinner at the historic McNinch House Restaurant. A refined culinary experience for discerning palates.

activities.title: Helicopter Tour of Charlotte Skyline
activities.description: Take to the skies for a breathtaking helicopter tour of the Charlotte skyline. Enjoy unparalleled panoramic views of the city and surrounding areas.

activities.title: Silent Disco Dance Party
activities.description: Dance the night away at a Silent Disco Dance Party where multiple DJs battle for your attention through wireless headphones. Choose your vibe and groove under the stars.

activities.title: Paranormal Walking Tour of Historic Fourth Ward
activities.description: Explore the spooky side of Charlotte with a guided Paranormal Walking Tour through the historic Fourth Ward. Hear chilling ghost stories and learn about the neighborhood's eerie past.

activities.title: Adult Recess: Giant Games & Craft Beer
activities.description: Relive your childhood with an adult twist at this event featuring giant versions of classic games like Jenga and Connect Four, all while enjoying craft beers.

activities.title: Cult Classic Midnight Screening
activities.description: Join fellow film buffs for a midnight screening of a cult classic film. Expect a lively audience, themed costumes, and an unforgettable cinematic experience.

activities.title: Axe Throwing League Night
activities.description: Test your aim and competitive spirit at an Axe Throwing League Night. Learn to throw axes safely and compete against others in a thrilling and unusual sport.

activities.title: Drag Story Time for Adults
activities.description: Enjoy a humorous and engaging Drag Story Time specifically for adults. Queens will read witty and irreverent tales, offering a unique and entertaining evening.

activities.title: Drag Brunch at Buff Faye's
activities.description: Enjoy a fabulous themed Drag Brunch hosted by Charlotte's beloved Buff Faye. Expect high-energy performances, delicious food, and bottomless mimosas for a lively Saturday afternoon.

activities.title: Brewery Wrestling Night
activities.description: Witness live WWE-style wrestling bouts right in the taproom at NoDa Brewing Co. Grab a craft beer and enjoy the unexpected spectacle of professional wrestling.

activities.title: Zombie Apocalypse Escape Room Challenge
activities.description: Test your survival skills in a thrilling Zombie Apocalypse themed escape room challenge. Work with your team to solve puzzles and escape before time runs out.

activities.title: Gothic & Oddities Market
activities.description: Explore a unique Gothic & Oddities Market featuring vendors selling peculiar art, vintage curiosities, dark fashion, and handcrafted goods. A truly unconventional shopping experience.

activities.title: Pet Costume Contest & Yappy Hour
activities.description: Bring your furry friends dressed in their best costumes for a Pet Costume Contest during Yappy Hour. Enjoy drinks and watch adorable pets compete for prizes.

activities.title: Bad Art Night Competition
activities.description: Unleash your inner artist (or anti-artist) at a 'Bad Art Night' competition. The goal is to create the most hilariously terrible artwork, with prizes for the worst masterpieces.

activities.title: Retro Arcade Tournament
activities.description: Challenge your friends and other gamers in a Retro Arcade Tournament. Compete on classic arcade machines for bragging rights and prizes in a nostalgic setting.
